title: Be Strong, and Work
old_p1: The people were building the Lord’s house again. Some old people remembered the first one. It had been big and beautiful.
The Lord asked, “How does this new house look to you? Like nothing?” It looked so small next to the first one.
So the Lord sent Haggai with a message: “Be strong, all you people, and work. For I am with you.”
old_p2: The Lord said, “My Spirit is with you. Do not be afraid.” The Spirit is the Lord’s quiet help in our hearts. He promised, “In this place I will give peace.”
When a job feels too big, the Lord is with you too. Tonight, make strong arms. You can be brave, because the Lord is with you.
p1: The people worked hard to rebuild the Lord's temple. Some of the older people remembered the first temple, with all its beauty. When they looked at the new building, it seemed so small. Was their work even enough?
The Lord knew their hearts. Through the prophet Haggai, He gave them courage: 'Be strong ... and work: for I am with you.'
p2: The temple was not finished yet. There were still stones to lift and work to do. But the builders were not alone. The Lord promised His Spirit would stay with them, and He promised peace.

Maybe you have a big job that looks hard at first. You can begin with one little part, then another. Heavenly Father can help you be brave and keep going. Tonight, stretch your arms strong, then rest. He is with you.
note: Levi, 20 Nov 2026 ("Match up the story lantern stories with the published book"): p1 and p2 are the story words AS PRINTED in the published December book (We Have Waited for Him, on Amazon), first and second story page, word for word, so the Lantern, the app's Books page and the book a family bought read the same. The Christian edition reads God for Heavenly Father; p2_christian only where the printed words are Latter-day Saint teaching. The 29 Oct picture-book rewrite is kept as rewrite_p1/rewrite_p2.
rewrite_p1: The people were building the Lord’s house again. Some old people remembered the first one, so big and beautiful.
“How does this house look to you now?” the Lord asked. “Like nothing?” Next to the first one, it looked so small.
So Heavenly Father sent Haggai with a message. “Be strong, all you people, and work,” said the Lord. “For I am with you.”
rewrite_p2: The Lord said, “My Spirit stays with you. Fear not.” He promised this house would be even greater than the first. “In this place I will give peace.”
When a job feels too big, the Lord is with you too. Tonight, make strong arms and say, “I can keep going!”
